description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Lathliss.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
